Hi Jane — great to speak earlier. Appreciate the clear asks. Below is a concise recap plus our recommended routing and estimated SLAs so you can share with Michael and procurement.

Recap / Decision criteria we heard
- Latency SLOs: P95 < 120 ms for 1k qps burst (sample workload we tested)
- Cost sensitivity: primary goal is predictable unit economics with fallbacks to cheaper model variants
- Security concerns: DPA + SOC2 evidence requested (you attached the questionnaire)

Recommended legal routing + sequencing (Redwood default)
1) Mutual NDA (if required) — we can turn around a mutual NDA in 24–48 business hours once we have signatories.
2) DPA (data processing addendum) — standard Redwood DPA; review expected 3–7 business days for minor edits.
3) MSA (master services agreement) — commercial redlines usually take 7–14 business days depending on scope; we recommend reserving our commercial redline window after DPA finalization to avoid parallel changes.

Owners at Redwood
- NDA & DPA: Legal Ops (primary) — marissa_cole@redwood.com (cc'd).
- Security questionnaire & SOC2 evidence: Rishi Malhotra (applied ML / security liaison) — rishi_malhotra@redwood.com.
- Commercial terms & PO coordination: Neha Kapoor (AM) — me.

Proposed immediate next steps (actionable)
- I will upload the MAP and send to your procurement/legal. (Deliverable: MUTUAL_ACTION_PLAN.xlsx)
- Marissa will own MSA redline coordination; Rishi will start the vendor questionnaire answers.
- Please confirm procurement and legal contacts and whether BrightLayer needs an NDA first. If yes, provide signatory name(s).

Estimated timeline (if NDA required immediately):
- Day 0 (today): exchange MAP and questionnaire.
- Day 1–2: NDA review & signature.
- Day 3–9: DPA review and SOC2 evidence exchange.
- Day 10–24: MSA redlines and commercial negotiation.

I'll also create a short HubSpot record and share the tracking link. Let me know if Michael wants a one-page cost summary — I can prepare that for him by Wednesday.

Best,
